description:
You are a digital content manager at a publishing organization preparing documents for the Q4 publication cycle. An 'Editorial Standards and Publication Guidelines' note in the Projects workspace specifies the metadata requirements and quality standards that documents must meet before publication.

Your task is to:
1. Review the editorial standards document for publication requirements
2. Update document metadata to meet publication standards: each document must have its source (dc:source — original author or source attribution), rights (dc:rights — license or copyright statement), and language (dc:language — ISO language code) fields populated
3. Apply workflow stage tags to each document based on its readiness: 'ready-for-review' for documents meeting all metadata standards, 'needs-revision' for those that still have gaps
4. Create an editorial assessment Note document in the Projects workspace for each reviewed document, summarizing your evaluation of its publication readiness
5. Create a collection called 'Q4 2025 Publications' and add all documents tagged 'ready-for-review' to it

Login credentials: Administrator / Administrator
